blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Authorities in Loboc, Bohol are tracking down two suspects who allegedly stole a 1914 brass bell from St. Peter Parish Church in Poblacion Ondol around noon on Sunday, October 4, 2026. The Loboc Municipal Police Station received a report from a church staff member about the theft of the century-old brass bell. Based on the police investigation, Lito Buyod, a maintenance employee of St. Peter Parish Church, discovered that the bell was missing at around 7:50 a.m. on Monday, October 5.
